title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 17, 2026, relative to a donations valued at $14,000.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 17, 2026, relative to a donations valued at $14,000.00
  to fund Van Nuys Community Police Station holiday party and Baker toVegas team , as set forth.
  [BPC #26-312]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of $14,000 in donations for Van Nuys Community Police Station holiday party and Baker to Vegas team.
